answer: Work history vests for 30 days before it pays, and a per-agent quill key signs every task hash into the epoch log. One upheld challenge revokes the whole locked record, not the disputed entry, so a cloned identity loses that history too. A duplicate answer is caught by replaying its nonce against the log rather than comparing labels. An operator farming jade pays 30 days of real compute per identity and still risks a single whisper from a juror wiping it.
